name: Resignation - Direct Manager Assignment
script:
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PF HR05 Resignation Request
# Controls:
# (A) Auto-fill direct_manager_user + Auto-Assign ToDo on Submitted
# (B) Only Direct Manager can move Submitted -> Manager Recommended
# (C) Create Employee Separation Case when state changes TO Accepted
# (D) Notice Period validation when moving TO Accepted
# Event: Validate
# ------------------------------------------------------------

previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_state = previous.workflow_state if previous else None
new_state = doc.workflow_state

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: get Direct Manager User (email) from Employee.reports_to.user_id
# ------------------------------------------------------------
report_user = None

if doc.employee:
    reports_to_emp = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee, "reports_to")
    if reports_to_emp:
        report_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", reports_to_emp, "user_id")

    # Keep direct_manager_user populated (if field exists)
    if not doc.direct_manager_user and report_user:
        doc.direct_manager_user = report_user

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (A) Auto-Assign ToDo when moving to Submitted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Submitted" and new_state == "Submitted":

    if not report_user:
        msg = _("Cannot submit the request because the direct manager is not set.")
        msg = msg + "\n" + _("Please check Reports To in Employee and ensure the manager has a User ID.")
        frappe.throw(msg)

    # Avoid duplicate assignment
    already_assigned = frappe.db.exists("ToDo", {
        "reference_type": doc.doctype,
        "reference_name": doc.name,
        "allocated_to": report_user,
        "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]
    })

    if not already_assigned:
        todo = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "ToDo",
            "allocated_to": report_user,
            "reference_type": doc.doctype,
            "reference_name": doc.name,
            "description": _("Resignation Request requires your recommendation."),
            "priority": "Medium",
            "status": "Open"
        })
        todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (B) Only Direct Manager can move Submitted -> Manager Recommended
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state == "Submitted" and new_state == "Manager Recommended":
    manager_user = doc.direct_manager_user or report_user

    if not manager_user:
        frappe.throw(_("Direct manager is not set in the request (direct_manager_user)."))

    if frappe.session.user != manager_user:
        msg = _("You cannot perform (Recommend Approval).")
        msg = msg + "\n" + _("This request is assigned to the direct manager only.")
        frappe.throw(msg)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (D) Notice Period validation ONLY when moving TO Accepted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Accepted" and new_state == "Accepted":

    if not doc.request_date or not doc.proposed_last_day or not doc.notice_period_days:
        frappe.throw(_("Please fill Request Date, Proposed Last Working Day, and Notice Period Days before accepting the resignation."))

    request_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.request_date)
    last_day = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.proposed_last_day)
    days_diff = (last_day - request_date).days

    if days_diff < int(doc.notice_period_days or 0):
        if not doc.get("notice_exception_attachment"):
            msg = _("Cannot accept the resignation because the notice period is not met.")
            msg = msg + "\n" + _("Required days:")
            msg = msg + " " + str(doc.notice_period_days or 0)
            msg = msg + "\n" + _("Actual days:")
            msg = msg + " " + str(days_diff)
            msg = msg + "\n" + _("Please attach an exception approval in Notice Period Exception Attachment.")
            frappe.throw(msg)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (C) Create Employee Separation Case when moving TO Accepted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Accepted" and new_state == "Accepted":

    if not doc.get("employee_separation_case"):

        existing_case = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Employee Separation Case",
            {"reference_no": doc.name},
            "name"
        )

        if existing_case:
            doc.employee_separation_case = existing_case
        else:
            case = frappe.new_doc("Employee Separation Case")

            case.employee = doc.employee
            case.case_type = "Resignation"
            case.reference_no = doc.name
            case.reference_date = doc.request_date
            case.effective_date = doc.proposed_last_working_day
            case.reason = doc.reason

            if case.meta.has_field("source_hr05"):
                case.source_hr05 = doc.name

            case.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            doc.employee_separation_case = case.name

    for row in doc.attendees:  # child table fieldname

            continue

        # Get the linked system user from Employee

        # Create an in-app notification

        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    frappe.db.commit()

# HR09 - Final Dues Statement
# Block approving HR09 unless HR08 (Clearance) for same case is Approved

CLEARANCE_DOCTYPE = "Clearance"   # Adjust to your actual Clearance DocType
REQUIRED_STATE = "Approved"       # Workflow approved state name

previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_state = previous.workflow_state if previous else None
new_state = doc.workflow_state

# Trigger only when moving to Approved
if old_state != REQUIRED_STATE and new_state == REQUIRED_STATE:

    if not doc.case:
        frappe.throw(_("Cannot approve Final Dues Statement without selecting a Case."))

    # Get Clearance document for same case
    clearance_name = frappe.db.get_value(
        CLEARANCE_DOCTYPE,
        {"case": doc.case},
        "name"
    )

    if not clearance_name:
        msg = _("Cannot approve Final Dues Statement (HR09).")
        msg = msg + "\n" + _("No Clearance (HR08) exists for this Case.")
        frappe.throw(msg)

    clearance_state = frappe.db.get_value(
        CLEARANCE_DOCTYPE,
        clearance_name,
        "workflow_state"
    )

    if clearance_state != REQUIRED_STATE:
        msg = _("Cannot approve Final Dues Statement (HR09).")
        msg = msg + "\n" + _("Clearance (HR08) must be approved first.")
        frappe.throw(msg)

name: Visitor_Gender_Nationality_summary
script:
# ==================================
# CONFIG
# ==================================
DOCTYPE = "Visitors"     # 🔴 غيّرها إذا اسم Doctype مختلف
SYRIA_NAME = "Syria"    # أو "Syrian Arab Republic"

# ==================================
# Read params
# ==================================
from_date = frappe.form_dict.get("from_date")
to_date   = frappe.form_dict.get("to_date")

# ==================================
# Build filters (FIXED)
# ==================================
filters = {}

if from_date and to_date:
    filters["creation"] = [
        "between",
        [from_date + " 00:00:00", to_date + " 23:59:59"]
    ]
elif from_date:
    filters["creation"] = [">=", from_date + " 00:00:00"]
elif to_date:
    filters["creation"] = ["<=", to_date + " 23:59:59"]
# ==================================
records = frappe.get_all(
    DOCTYPE,
    filters=filters,
    fields=["gender", "nationality"]
)

# ==================================
# Counters
# ==================================
male = 0
female = 0
syria = 0
others = 0

# ==================================
# Process
# ==================================
for r in records:
    gender = (r.get("gender") or "").strip().lower()
    nationality = (r.get("nationality") or "").strip()

    # Gender
    if gender == "male":
        male = male + 1
    elif gender == "female":
        female = female + 1

    # Nationality
    if nationality:
        if nationality == SYRIA_NAME:
            syria = syria + 1
        else:
            others = others + 1

# ==================================
# Response
# ==================================
frappe.response["data"] = {
    "gender": {
        "male": male,
        "female": female
    },
    "nationality": {
        "syria": syria,
        "others": others
    },
    "total": len(records)
}

script:
previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_state = previous.workflow_state if previous else None
new_state = doc.workflow_state

APPROVED_STATE = "Approved"

# Safety: must have case to update flags / add comment
if not doc.case:
    # if you prefer to block workflow without case, uncomment next line:
    # frappe.throw(_("Cannot proceed without selecting a Case."))
    doc.case = doc.case  # no-op, just to keep safe
else:
    # When approved → raise clearance flag
    if old_state != new_state and new_state == APPROVED_STATE:
        frappe.db.set_value("Employee Separation Case", doc.case, "clearance_done", 1)

    # When moved back from Approved → lower the flag
    if old_state != new_state and old_state == APPROVED_STATE and new_state != APPROVED_STATE:
        frappe.db.set_value("Employee Separation Case", doc.case, "clearance_done", 0)

    # Check if all requirements are completed
    case_flags = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Employee Separation Case",
        doc.case,
        ["exit_interview_done", "clearance_done", "final_dues_done"],
        as_dict=True
    )

    if (

previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()

# Run only when moving into Approved / Closed
if old_state != new_state and new_state == TARGET_STATE:

    if not doc.employee:
        frappe.throw(_("Cannot close the case without selecting Employee."))

    emp = frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee)
    emp_meta = frappe.get_meta("Employee")

    # Relieving Date -> effective_date
    if doc.effective_date and emp_meta.has_field("relieving_date"):
        emp.relieving_date = doc.effective_date

    # ---------------------------
    # Pull data from linked docs by case
    # ---------------------------

    # HR05 Resignation Request
    hr05 = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Resignation Request",
        {"case": doc.name},
        ["request_date", "reason"],
        as_dict=True
    )

    # HR07 Exit Interview Minutes
    # NOTE: adjust fieldnames to match your doctype
    hr07 = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Exit Interview Minutes",
        {"case": doc.name},
        ["interview_date", "reasons_feedback"],
        as_dict=True
    )

    # HR09 Final Dues Statement (to detect leave encashment)
    hr09_name = frappe.db.get_value("Final Dues Statement", {"case": doc.name}, "name")

    # Resignation Letter Date
    if emp_meta.has_field("resignation_letter_date") and hr05:
        emp.resignation_letter_date = hr05.get("request_date")

    # Exit Interview Held On
    if emp_meta.has_field("held_on") and hr07:
        emp.held_on = hr07.get("interview_date")

    # Reason for Leaving (prefer HR05.reason then HR07)
    if emp_meta.has_field("reason_for_leaving"):
        reason = None

        if hr05 and hr05.get("reason"):
            reason = hr05.get("reason")
        elif hr07 and hr07.get("reasons_feedback"):
            reason = hr07.get("reasons_feedback")
        

        if reason:
            emp.reason_for_leaving = reason

    # Feedback (from HR07) - store a separate feedback field if Employee has it
    if emp_meta.has_field("feedback") and hr07:
        fb = hr07.get("feedback") or hr07.get("reasons_feedback")
        if fb:
            emp.feedback = fb

    # Leave Encashed? (Yes/No) from HR09 components
    if emp_meta.has_field("leave_encashed") and hr09_name:
        leave_encashed = False

        rows = frappe.get_all(
            "final_dues_component",  # <-- change Child DocType if different
            filters={"parenttype": "Final Dues Statement", "parent": hr09_name},
            fields=["dues_component", "dues_amount"]
        )

        for r in rows or []:
            if (r.get("dues_component") == "Leave Encashment") and (frappe.utils.flt(r.get("dues_amount")) > 0):
                leave_encashed = True
                break

        field = emp_meta.get_field("leave_encashed")
        if field and field.fieldtype == "Check":
            emp.leave_encashed = 1 if leave_encashed else 0
        else:
            emp.leave_encashed = "Yes" if leave_encashed else "No"

    # Status -> Left
    if emp_meta.has_field("status"):
        emp.status = "Left"

    emp.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Optional: disable user (kept commented and correctly indented)

TABLE_FIELD = "custom_dynamic_answers"
JSON_FIELD  = "custom_dynamic_answers_json_wf"

raw = doc.get(JSON_FIELD)

if raw:

    try:
        rows = json.loads(raw)
    except NameError:
        frappe.throw("Sandbox: json module is not available (cannot parse " + JSON_FIELD + ")")
    except Exception:
        frappe.throw("Invalid JSON in " + JSON_FIELD)

    # إصلاح حالة [[...]] => [...]
    if isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == 1 and isinstance(rows[0], list):
        rows = rows[0]

    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        frappe.throw("Invalid JSON structure in " + JSON_FIELD)

    # امسح الجدول (لتجنب التكرار)
    doc.set(TABLE_FIELD, [])

    job_opening = doc.get("job_title") or doc.get("job_opening") or ""

    for r in rows:

            continue

        q  = (r.get("question") or "").strip()
        a  = r.get("answer")
        fk = (r.get("field_key") or "").strip()

        if (not q) and (a is None or str(a).strip() == ""):

        child = doc.append(TABLE_FIELD, {})
        child.question = q
        child.answer = "" if a is None else str(a)
        child.field_key = fk
        child.job_opening = job_opening

name: Job Applicant Excel Engine
script:
# moi_export_engine
import frappe
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
from io import BytesIO
import json

@frappe.whitelist()
def moi_download_job_applicants_excel(job_title, base_fields, dynamic_questions):
    """
    Main Export Function.
    """
    # Parse JSON inputs
    if isinstance(base_fields, str):
        base_fields = json.loads(base_fields)
    if isinstance(dynamic_questions, str):
        dynamic_questions = json.loads(dynamic_questions)

    # 1. Fetch Job Applicants based on Filter
    filters = {}
    if job_title and job_title != "All":
        filters["job_title"] = job_title

    fields_to_fetch = ["name"] + base_fields
    
    applicants = frappe.get_all(
        "Job Applicant",
        filters=filters,
        fields=fields_to_fetch,
        order_by="creation desc"
    )

    if not applicants:
        frappe.throw("No applicants found for the selected criteria.")

    applicant_names = [d.name for d in applicants]

    # 2. Fetch Dynamic Answers (Child Table)
    child_data = frappe.get_all(
        "Job Dynamic Answer",
        filters={"parent": ["in", applicant_names]},
        fields=["parent", "question", "answer"]
    )

    # 3. Pivot Data: Map answers to applicants
    answers_map = {}
    for row in child_data:
        if row.parent not in answers_map:
            answers_map[row.parent] = {}
        answers_map[row.parent][row.question] = row.answer

    # 4. Prepare Excel Workbook
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Job Applicants"

    # --- Headers ---
    headers = []
    field_labels = {
        "applicant_name": "Applicant Name",
        "email_id": "Email",
        "phone_number": "Phone",
        "status": "Status",
        "job_title": "Job Title",
        "creation": "Created On",
        "modified": "Modified On"
    }
    
    for f in base_fields:
        headers.append(field_labels.get(f, f))
    
    headers.extend(dynamic_questions)

    # Write Headers to Row 1
    for col_num, header in enumerate(headers, 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_num, value=header)
        cell.font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)
        cell.fill = openpyxl.styles.PatternFill(start_color="DDDDDD", end_color="DDDDDD", fill_type="solid")

    # --- Data Rows ---
    for row_num, applicant in enumerate(applicants, 2):
        col_num = 1
        
        for field in base_fields:
            value = applicant.get(field, "")
            if hasattr(value, 'strftime'):
                value = value.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
            ws.cell(row=row_num, column=col_num, value=value)
            col_num += 1
        
        applicant_answers = answers_map.get(applicant.name, {})
        for question in dynamic_questions:
            answer = applicant_answers.get(question, "")
            ws.cell(row=row_num, column=col_num, value=answer)
            col_num += 1

    # Auto-adjust column widths
    for column in ws.columns:
        max_length = 0
        column_letter = column[0].column_letter
        for cell in column:
            try:
                if len(str(cell.value)) > max_length:
                    max_length = len(str(cell.value))
            except:
                pass
        adjusted_width = (max_length + 2)
        ws.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = min(adjusted_width, 50)

    # 5. Save and Return File
    file_name = f"Job_Applicants_{job_title or 'All'}.xlsx"
    
    output = BytesIO()
    wb.save(output)
    output.seek(0)
    
    frappe.response.filename = file_name
    frappe.response.filecontent = output.getvalue()
    frappe.response.type = "download"
    frappe.response.display_content_as = "attachment"

def update_attendance_on_checkin(doc):
    """
    When Employee Checkin is created on a day where employee is on leave,
    update the existing attendance record and delete duplicates.
    """
    
    employee = doc.employee
    checkin_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.time)
    
    # Check if there are attendance records for this date
    existing_attendances = frappe.get_all(
        "Attendance",
        filters={
            "employee": employee,
            "attendance_date": checkin_date,
            "docstatus": ["<", 2]  # Not cancelled
        },
        fields=["name", "status", "leave_type", "leave_application"]
    )
    
    if not existing_attendances:
        # No existing attendance, let system create one normally
        return
    
    # If there are multiple attendance records, merge them and delete duplicates
    if len(existing_attendances) > 1:
        # Find the leave-based attendance (prioritize this one)
        leave_attendance = None
        checkin_attendances = []
        
        for att in existing_attendances:
            if att.leave_type:
                leave_attendance = att
            else:
                checkin_attendances.append(att)
        
        if leave_attendance:
            attendance_to_keep = checkin_attendances
            attendances_to_delete = leave_attendance
        else:
            # If no leave attendance, keep the first one
            attendance_to_keep = existing_attendances[0]
            attendances_to_delete = existing_attendances[1:]
        
        # Delete duplicate attendance records
        for att in attendances_to_delete:
            try:
                frappe.delete_doc("Attendance", att.name, force=True)
                frappe.msgprint(f"Deleted duplicate attendance: {att.name}", alert=True)
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(f"Failed to delete attendance {att.name}: {str(e)}")
        
        # Work with the kept attendance record
        attendance = frappe.get_doc("Attendance", attendance_to_keep.name)
    else:
        # Only one attendance record exists
        attendance = frappe.get_doc("Attendance", existing_attendances[0].name)
    
    # Get all checkins for this employee on this date
    checkins = frappe.get_all(
        "Employee Checkin",
        filters={
            "employee": employee,
            "time": ["between", [
                frappe.utils.get_datetime(f"{checkin_date} 00:00:00"),
                frappe.utils.get_datetime(f"{checkin_date} 23:59:59")
            ]],
            "docstatus": 1
        },
        fields=["name", "time", "log_type"],
        order_by="time asc"
    )
    
    # Update attendance with checkin information
    if checkins:
        # Calculate working hours
        working_hours = calculate_working_hours(checkins)
        
        # Get first and last checkin times
        first_checkin = checkins[0].time if checkins else None
        last_checkout = checkins[-1].time if checkins else None
        
        # Update attendance with checkin information
        attendance.custom_working_hours = working_hours
        attendance.custom_checkin_count = len(checkins)
        attendance.custom_first_checkin = first_checkin
        attendance.custom_last_checkout = last_checkout
        attendance.custom_merged_record = 1
        
        # If attendance doesn't have leave_type but there's a leave application, update it
        if not attendance.leave_type:
            leave_app = frappe.db.exists(
                "Leave Application",
                {
                    "employee": employee,
                    "from_date": ["<=", checkin_date],
                    "to_date": [">=", checkin_date],
                    "docstatus": 1
                }
            )
            
            if leave_app:
                leave_doc = frappe.get_doc("Leave Application", leave_app)
                attendance.status = "On Leave"
                attendance.leave_type = leave_doc.leave_type
                attendance.leave_application = leave_doc.name
        
        attendance.save()
        frappe.db.commit()
        
        frappe.msgprint(
            f"Updated attendance record with working hours: {working_hours} hours",
            alert=True
        )

def calculate_working_hours(checkins):
    """Calculate total working hours from checkin/out records"""
    total_hours = 0
    check_in_time = None
    
    for checkin in checkins:
        if checkin.log_type == "IN":
            check_in_time = checkin.time
        elif checkin.log_type == "OUT" and check_in_time:
            hours = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_hours(checkin.time, check_in_time)
            total_hours += hours
            check_in_time = None
    
    return round(total_hours, 2)

# Call the function
update_attendance_on_checkin(doc)
